layers.description: Land use and land cover areas. Area-based thresholds: >=1 km2 from z8, >=0.1 km2 from z10, >=1 ha from z12, >=1000 m2 from z13, all from z14.

fields.class: park | grass | wood | farmland | cemetery | sport | residential | commercial | industrial | construction | education | hospital | parking | bare | wetland
fields.kind: source tag as key=value, e.g. leisure=park

layers.description: Water areas (natural=water, riverbank, dock, reservoir, basin), with the same area thresholds as landcover but all remaining areas from z13.

fields.kind: water tag value (lake, pond, basin, reservoir, ...) or water
fields.name: name tag

layers.description: Rivers and canals from z10; streams, drains and ditches from z13.
Building footprints; >=5000 m2 from z13, all from z14.
Roads, paths and railways. motorway z5, trunk z6, primary z8, secondary z9, rail z10, tertiary z11, minor z13, service/track/path z14.

fields.class: motorway | trunk | primary | secondary | tertiary | minor | service | track | path | rail
fields.name: name tag

layers.description: Label points of named place=* features. city z8, town z10, suburb z11, quarter/village z12, neighbourhood z13, others z14.

fields.name: display name (name, else name:fa, else name:en)
fields.rank: integer importance, lower is more important

layers.description: Label points of named points of interest. Areas >=0.2 km2 from z12, >=2 ha from z13, rank <=6 from z14, rank <=9 from z15, others from z16.

fields.category: tag key that classified the feature (amenity, shop, tourism, ...)
fields.name: display name (name, else name:fa, else name:en)
fields.rank: integer importance, lower is more important
